problem_plain: A manufacturing client needed to transform their operations using AI to realise their vision of a "non-stop factory" and strengthen their ability to respond to demand fluctuations.
capability: AI implementation in manufacturing operations and related processes, including digital verification in cyber-physical space, IT architecture development, governance frameworks, and embedded engineering team model
reusable: Embedded Engineering Pod model (small teams operating in short transformation cycles), performance-based contract model linking compensation to achievement of success metrics, AI governance frameworks (IT architecture, development/maintenance processes, data and intellectual property governance)
summary: Murata and Validyne entered a three-year strategic partnership in October 2026 to advance manufacturing transformation through AI implementation across production floors and related operations. The engagement employs Validyne's Embedded Engineering Pod model with performance-based contracting and focuses on advanced quality management, digital verification, IT governance, and capability building.
